note: Cambodia: holders of ordinary passports of the countries the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation lists enter without a visa (Thailand 60 days; Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, the Maldives, the Philippines, Singapore and Vietnam 30; Seychelles 15; Brunei and Myanmar 14); citizens of any other country may get a visa on arrival, or an e-Visa online beforehand, for a stay of up to 30 days. Read from Wikipedia's copy of the ministry's list.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Cambodia
sources.said: According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Cambodia, holders of ordinary passports of the following countries may enter Cambodia without a visa for stays up to the duration listed below: 60 days Thailand 30 days Indonesia Laos Malaysia Maldives Philippines Singapore Vietnam 15 days Seychelles 14 days Brunei Myanmar ... Citizens of any country may obtain a visa on arrival or electronic visa. Visa on arrival is good for tourism (30 USD ) or business purposes (35 USD), for a maximum stay of 30 days.
